attempted_claim: Let d=13 and for c in (0,3/13) cap Q let P^K_{13,c} be the K-moduli good moduli space of K-polystable Q-Gorenstein smoothable log Fano pairs (X,cD) deforming (P^2,cC), C a plane curve of degree 13, as in Ascher-DeVleming-Liu. Is P^K_{13,c'} --> P^K_{13,c} a birational contraction for every 0<c<c'<3/13? Equivalently (Prop. 9.8): if X is a Manetti surface with dim Aut(X)=9 and (X,cD) is K-stable for some 0<c<3/13 and general D in |-13/3 K_X|, does lct(X;D) >= 3/13 hold?
